lines.en: I run over the badlands' rubble.
Small frame, quick steps.
Three toes grip the red clay.
I follow behind my packmates.
Sniffing while I run.
I cross the cracked ground.

lines.zh: 我踩着自己的影子快跑。
lines.en: I race along my own shadow.
Red sand blows into my face.
I hop down from a ledge.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下一串小脚印。
lines.en: A string of tiny tracks trails behind me.
Looking for a burrow to duck into.
Run a stretch, then look back.

lines.zh: 沙土被我的爪子带起来。
lines.en: My claws kick up dust.
Several of us move together.
I crouch on the rock.
Neck up, listening.
Red clay stains my claws.

lines.zh: 我这么小，得等同伴先叫。
lines.en: I am small. I wait for the others to call.

lines.zh: 我小小的，不容易被发现。
lines.en: I'm small and easy to miss.
The badlands are too hot by day.
Red sand slides off my scales.
There's a bigger pack far off.
I've tucked under a stone.
My breathing is short and fast.
The badlands sun won't set yet.
I turn an ear to the wind.
I tilt my head and watch.
I keep looking left and right.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了我藏身的枯枝。
lines.en: You snapped the dry twig I hid under.

lines.zh: 你的影子把我全盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers all of me.
I won't take a single step forward.
You stand out on this red clay.
I can run very fast.
There are several of us.

lines.zh: 我从你的靴子后面探头。
lines.en: I peek out from behind your boot.
I'm watching your shadow.
Crouching would only scare me more.
Please don't take another step.

lines.zh: 我一只脚已经在往后挪。
lines.en: One foot is already moving back.
I don't like looking up at you.
I bolt up and land again.
I curl up against the red rock.
One leg won't quite obey.
I squeal and snap at the air.
A few drops of blood on the sand.
All four feet still answer me.
The pack is all watching me.
Sand fills every gap between my scales.
I crouched lower.
I can still bite.
Is that thing meat?
I want meat with blood on it.
Throw it further away.
Too little to share.
The smell of blood is enough.
I prefer something small.
What are you doing with that?
Put it down on the stone.
Is that thing alive?
I should check with the pack first.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖碰到了我的背。
lines.en: Your boot tip grazed my back.
I shoot across the sand.
Don't crowd us. We're small.

lines.zh: 我的手肘碰到了你的靴。
lines.en: My elbow met your boot.

lines.zh: 我从你的两腿之间穿过去了。
lines.en: I darted between your legs.
You broke the crusted sand.
Two steps back is enough.
Don't move your foot yet.

lines.zh: 我们聚到一块石头后面。
lines.en: We gather behind a stone.
Touch me once more and I bite.
Pairing only happens in the warm season.
That's up to the pack.
I haven't grown yet.
When this season's wind cools.
Even kin fight over a meal.
I don't intend to discuss it.
The several of us walked off.
Go ask another dinosaur.
I lower my head and keep sniffing.
This isn't the place for it.

lines.zh: 恶地的缝里，我一钻就没。
lines.en: One duck into a badland crack and I am gone.
Not meat. I won't touch it.
A bone. I'll take it.
This meat drags me off balance.
I take it and shake it.
I drag it back to the nest.
This has a smell of blood.
I can't hold it, so I let go.
The pack would want this.
Too small. Not worth it.
The shadow under the ledge moved.
My eyes are on its feet.
It's smaller than me. Worth a try.
First I drop low.
No cover on the badlands.
I slip around through the rocks.
My claws hold the ground.
I'll wait for the pack.
I can dash from here.
I crouch low, tail flat on the sand.
My tail goes rigid; ready to run.
The rocks' edge is best.
I creep along the rock seam.

lines.zh: 我小跑着咬住它的影子。
lines.en: I trot after its shadow.
It's between two stones.
I come round from downwind.
I keep my belly to the sand.
It's head-down, foraging.

lines.zh: 我们分头围住这个大家伙。
lines.en: We split up to ring this big one.
The wind is scattering the scent.

lines.zh: 我们六个一起出来，你只看见我。
lines.en: Six of us came out; you see only me.
One more inch and I reach.
Its shadow falls on the clay.

lines.zh: 我只有十点血，可跑得快。
lines.en: Ten health, but quick on my feet.
It turned. I wait.
One pounce reaches from here.
It's heading for the ledge.

lines.zh: 我这条小身子只值十点血。
lines.en: This little body holds only ten health.
It's still eating right now.
It's still head-down, eating.
I'm nearly flat to the ground.
I bite and pull backward.
I pounce and pin it.
That caught skin.
It's bigger, but I'm quicker.
I ram it from the side.
It threw me off hard.
I bite down and don't let go.
I bite your ankle from the side.
My teeth only scrape your leather.
I break off and circle again.
Dust rises and blocks my eyes.
It hit the rock.
My hind legs pushed hard.
It's running for open ground.
I won't chase very far.
That's enough for a meal.
I peer out of a rock crevice.
Badlands red dirt burns my feet.
Several of us appeared together.
Red dunes stretch under my feet.
The wind blows across the ledge.
I climb out of a sand pit.
I rise with my body low.
I've never been on this badland.
Two steps to test my legs.
I've found my packmates.
Sun makes the red clay glow.
I crouch beside a stone.
My breathing settles.
These badlands are vast.
I haven't picked a direction.
More footsteps approach.
Fire scorches the soles of my feet.
I rolled off the ledge.
There shouldn't be water here.
The blast threw up a sheet of red clay.
An arrow went through my leg.
That light made my hide prickle.
My small legs are shaking.
Lightning struck the ledge.
There's no red clay under me.
